purpose: Recovery benchmarks for a DESI Legacy Surveys photometric satellite-search pilot; not a completeness-selected population sample

units.theta_half_arcmin: projected circularized half-light angular radius in arcmin
units.rhalf_pc: projected circularized half-light physical radius in pc

radius_policy: Never treat native catalog rhalf as automatically circularized. Canonical theta_half_arcmin and rhalf_pc are explicitly circularized; derived quantities are labeled. Separately marginalized/rounded published summaries need not obey exact central-value geometric identities. No 3D deprojection is applied.
coverage_policy: Every LS DR11 footprint and usable-gr status is unknown until runtime checking. Do not equate census DES/DELVE/PS1 region with Legacy coverage. Unknown is null, not false.
catalog_version_policy: Source CSVs are pinned to immutable commits; primary papers are pinned to arXiv versions. Current LVDB crosschecks are retained without silently replacing adopted values.
run_policy: Start with 3 strong controls, then the remaining 9 first_run diagnostic systems.
Verify footprint and quality before categorizing non-recovery; preserve known-system tag bits for control runs while honoring actual invalid-image masks.
Run blind scans over local cutouts; a forced-center statistic is a separate diagnostic, not blind-search recovery.
Use a predeclared angular/distance matching rule and retain matched and missed outputs; do not tune until every source appears.
Use later withheld fields and injections for honest performance estimates; these known systems are not a selection-function training truth set.
Stress extension contains systems outside baseline distance/scale/latitude support and published photometric candidates; none is an unconditional must-pass unit test.
